follow-up time: Time between first and second childbirth (exact duration not specified)
outcome: Prelabor cesarean delivery in the second childbirth
cohort: 44,656 women in Sweden having a first birth with vacuum extraction and a second birth between 2000-2014
finding: Lateral or mediolateral episiotomy at vacuum extraction in nulliparous women did not increase the risk of prelabor cesarean delivery in the subsequent childbirth, while OASIS increased the odds more than sixfold.
mod_finding: This study found that lateral or mediolateral episiotomy at vacuum extraction in nulliparous women did not increase the risk of prelabor cesarean delivery in the subsequent childbirth.
